status: FROZEN at the commit that first adds this file: after the diagnosis receipt (state/s5e/diag/diag_receipt.json, sha256 f0880725...) and its independent review (state/s5e/diag/review-round-1.md; findings F1-F7 accepted, record revised), BEFORE any candidate run and before any assessment seed. It freezes the candidate decision, candidate R, its development plan and the complete assessment construction with its acceptance and useful-width criteria (the contract allows the assessment freeze later; it is frozen now, which is stricter).

decision.R_support: diagnosis D7 NAMES refinement-classifier capacity as the cause of the nominal background-related bias under the contract's attribution rule (paired background-inclusive minus signal-only, 12 seeds: max |t| 11.2 -> 4.0, biased cells' mean shift -90%; closure-vs-truth max |t| 6.9 -> 2.8). It is a targeted refinement repair, authorized by section 1 of the authorization

not_chosen.iterations_or_stopping: measured PARTIAL effect below the predeclared screen (review F1): on the noise-free construction the E_avail median falls 25.8% and the max 18.4% from k = 5 to 30 and is still falling (~0.1 pp per iteration), so the screen's 'no' is set by the K_max = 30 cap; for q3 the residual grows with iterations (+31%) and early stopping lowers it (-34% at k = 1) only with a far worse fold. A candidate must be SUPPORTED by a rule; none fires, and even an extrapolation of the E_avail trend to ~50 iterations leaves a median of several percent and tens of percent at high W against a statistical sigma of ~0.2%, while degrading q3, so no iteration or stopping candidate could meet an acceptance criterion without inflating errors. A dedicated convergence study is costed as a separate next step
not_chosen.classifier_capacity: supported by its rule only for the q3 stress deformation (k = 15: -49% in the median, the maximum unchanged at ~41%); for the physically anchored E_avail departure it changes the median by -1.5% (k = 5) and +12% (k = 15) while improving only the reco fit; the forecast development residual (median ~10%, max ~68% at the anchor) cannot meet any useful acceptance criterion without inflating errors
not_chosen.missed_event_regression: measured PARTIAL effect below the screen (review F1): without the regressor the q3 median improves 13-15% (with a worse fold) while E_avail gets worse; not supported by its rule and it trades one departure against the other
not_chosen.second_candidate: none is justified; one candidate is chosen

decision.scope_of_R: R is a remedy for the nominal background-related bias (KNOWN_ISSUES 75's residual, s5n C3) ONLY. It cannot and does not remedy the departure response (KNOWN_ISSUES 77): the diagnosis finds no authorized estimator change supported by its predeclared screen for the physical E_avail departure (iterations: a partial, still-continuing effect far from the statistical scale; capacity: none). The departure residual is therefore measured and reported as a model-dependence (unfolding-model) quantity, separately from the statistical interval, and it gates the scope of any qualification (A4); it is never folded into or used to widen the statistical interval
decision.review: state/s5e/diag/review-round-1.md: all diagnosis numbers reproduced from operands; F1 (factors with partial effects had been labelled excluded) and F2 (observability overstated; a slow-convergence component is present) accepted; neither changes which rule fired, and the named D7 cause is confirmed (direct refinement-capacity minus B0: max |t| 12.5, 61 functionals)

development_exit_change.contract_text: a candidate proceeds to assessment only if K1 passes and K2 and K3 improve on B0's decisive metric
development_exit_change.for_R: R proceeds to assessment if K1 passes and K2 and K3 are NOT WORSE than B0 (median and max |EW residual| each within +10% relative of B0's s5n values); K4 and K5 are measured and reported
development_exit_change.why: R's declared scope is the background bias; the diagnosis (receipt f0880725, independently reviewed) establishes that the departure residual is not changed by any authorized estimator change the rules support, so requiring R to improve it would make the only supported repair untestable. This is an explicit change of a campaign-internal screen, declared before any candidate data, not a change of a retained scientific gate; the departure residual still gates the qualified scope through A4

candidate.name: R

assessment.data: R on the real data (npz path) with its 100-replica repaired bootstrap (seeds 1-100): the same estimator and interval construction intended for data; reported as a pipeline validation and as method sensitivity against B0, never as a corrected central value
assessment.scale: development scale (40 nominal, 20 per departure): enough to reject R or bound its behaviour; not a coverage validation

C3.text: no reported functional with |mean residual|/SE > 3.6, and none with |mean pull| > 0.5 and |t| > 3 (the s5n C3 criterion, unchanged)

calibration.text: at nominal (40 fresh experiments): pooled pull SD in [0.9, 1.1]; at most 10% of functionals with a pull SD outside 1 +- 3 SE (SE = 1/sqrt(2(n-1))); on the 42 EW cells, the mean Hartlap-corrected Mahalanobis statistic with the 100-replica covariance within [0.8, 1.2] x 42

useful_width.text: the statistical interval is not widened to buy closure: sigma_R / sigma_B0 over the 42 EW cells has median <= 1.25 and max <= 2.0 (B0 = the s5n 200-replica sigma)

criteria.A1: C3 on the 40 fresh nominal experiments
criteria.A3: every seed and permutation probe moves every functional by <= 0.05 sigma, AND on the real data the edge-safe rounding probe moves the functionals by <= 0.3 data-sigma in the median and <= 1.0 data-sigma at most
criteria.A4: model dependence: per EW cell, MD = max over W1-W3 of |mean relative residual|; a cell is inside the qualified scope only if MD <= the adopted C_EW total sigma of the cell (state/s5c/d1/bias_vs_adopted.json sigma_adopted_pct, projection 835828bf); the scope must be non-empty. The GiBUU and q3 fresh-seed residuals are reported beside it
criteria.verdict: A_PASS_DEVELOPMENT_SCALE iff A1, A2, A3, A5 pass and the A4 scope is non-empty (the qualification is then statistical-scope, at nominal truth, for the A4 cells only, with the model dependence reported separately); otherwise A_FAIL naming every failed criterion. Nothing is adopted either way
